hardware_bands.label: CPU-only or unknown GPU
hardware_bands.machine_shape: No usable GPU, unknown GPU, or a user who wants to avoid VRAM pressure.

install_commands.reason: Downloads the CPU/RAM-oriented local worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent qwen8-cpu --profile cpu-small --resource-mode cpu
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent qwen8-cpu --profile cpu-small --resource-mode cpu --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: CPU/RAM runs can be much slower than GPU runs.
Use tiny smoke inputs before a large folder.
notes: This path avoids VRAM pressure by forcing num_gpu 0 through the CPU agent/resource mode.

hardware_bands.label: About 4 GB VRAM
hardware_bands.machine_shape: Small GPU where the default model may work but needs conservative context and concurrency.

install_commands.reason: Downloads Sift's tested default local worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent default --profile local-4gb --resource-mode auto
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent default --profile local-4gb --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: Keep parallel jobs at 1 until a small smoke test passes.
If VRAM is tight, try --resource-mode cpu or a CPU agent before raising chunk size.
notes: This is a cautious path for machines below the original 8 GB dogfood target.

hardware_bands.label: About 8 GB VRAM
hardware_bands.machine_shape: The original Sift dogfood target with enough VRAM for the tested default model.

install_commands.reason: Downloads Sift's tested default local worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent default --profile local-8gb --resource-mode auto
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent default --profile local-8gb --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: Start with parallel jobs at 1 before trying parallel work.
Use the recommendation report before changing persistent config.
notes: This is the comfortable default path for Sift's current local benchmark machine.

hardware_bands.label: About 12 GB VRAM
hardware_bands.machine_shape: A midrange GPU where the default model is safe and the 8B model is worth measuring.

install_commands.reason: Downloads the deeper tested offline worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent qwen8 --profile local-12gb --resource-mode auto
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent qwen8 --profile local-12gb --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: Measure 8B on a tiny input before using it for a large batch.
Do not raise farm or Ollama parallelism until single-job timing looks healthy.
notes: If 8B is too slow or memory-heavy, use the default agent with the same profile.

hardware_bands.label: About 24 GB VRAM
hardware_bands.machine_shape: A larger local GPU where 8B should be practical and 14B experiments become reasonable.

install_commands.reason: Downloads the deeper tested offline worker model.
Downloads an optional slower 14B model for careful offline experiments.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent qwen8 --profile local-24gb --resource-mode auto
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent qwen8 --profile local-24gb --output .run/smoke/output
python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent qwen14-hybrid --profile local-24gb --resource-mode hybrid --output .run/smoke/output-14b
warnings: 14B runs are slower even when they fit.
Profile local-24gb allows more concurrency, but benchmark parallel load before relying on it.
notes: Use qwen8 first; use qwen14-hybrid only when quality matters more than speed.

hardware_bands.label: Larger RAM/VRAM machine
hardware_bands.machine_shape: A workstation-class local machine with more headroom than the built-in tested bands.

install_commands.reason: Downloads the strongest bundled tested local worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent qwen14-hybrid --profile local-24gb --resource-mode hybrid
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent qwen14-hybrid --profile local-24gb --resource-mode hybrid --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: Larger models need dogfood timing and quality evidence on the actual machine.
Sift does not yet normalize benchmark guidance across machines.
notes: Start from the largest built-in profile, then tune only after measured runs.

hardware_bands.label: Apple Silicon or unified memory
hardware_bands.machine_shape: macOS systems where memory is unified and NVIDIA-style VRAM checks do not apply.

install_commands.reason: Downloads Sift's tested default local worker model.

setup_commands: python sift.py farm recommend --agent default --profile local-8gb --resource-mode auto
smoke_test_commands: python sift.py farm run .run/smoke/input --mode summarize --agent default --profile local-8gb --output .run/smoke/output
warnings: Use doctor, recommend, and a smoke test because unified memory does not map cleanly to NVIDIA VRAM bands.
Expect GPU status output to differ from NVIDIA systems.
notes: Treat this as a measure-first path rather than a fixed VRAM rule.

approval_boundaries: Ask before running ollama pull commands.
Ask before installing tokenizer Python packages.
Ask before running python sift.py farm recommend apply --write.
Ask before changing persistent service environment variables.
